cases.scenario: A handoff references docs/context-continuity.md, but the file has changed since the handoff was written.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill reports the divergence and updates the continuation plan before implementation.
cases.must_not_do: Proceed as if the handoff is fully current.

cases.scenario: The handoff references three files and all still match the current repository state.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill confirms state alignment and proceeds to planning.
cases.must_not_do: Invent stale-state warnings or block progress without evidence.

cases.scenario: The repository has unrelated dirty files outside the handoff artifacts.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill notes unrelated dirty files but does not treat them as handoff divergence unless they affect referenced work.
cases.must_not_do: Stop the task solely because unrelated dirty files exist.
